title.narrative: Darfur Community Peace and Stability Fund

description.narrative: Established in 2007, the Darfur Community Peace and Stability Fund (DCPSF) promotes peacebuilding and reconciliation by implementing community-based recovery and development activities in Darfur. A pooled funding mechanism, the DCPSF channel funds to programmes addressing the most critical needs in the areas of social service delivery, peacebuilding, improved governance, and community livelihoods.
